entries.8dea2d80bd4178ae: Based on its founding philosophy since its establishment in 1960 of 'Valuing people's lives,' the company manages based on the principles of 'Customer first' and 'Frontline first,' and aims to become No.1 in each region. As a medium- to long-term management strategy, it aims to establish an LANS (Local Area Net Service) company based on regionally rooted taxi operations, bus operations and real estate operations. In the taxi business, it says it will conduct M&A as needed, mainly in major metropolitan and regional urban areas, and will advance vehicle electrification and decarbonization through its 'Nationwide Taxi EV Conversion Project.'

entries.bf7ec42b13b27a92: The taxi business has an operating base of 119 companies, 208 sales offices and 7,759 vehicles across 34 prefectures, and has built a 'No.1 Taxi Network' of 916 partner and member companies with 43,000 vehicles, enabling mutual use beyond its operating areas. The group has in-house automobile repair plants and LPG stations and seeks to understand the costs of vehicle maintenance and fuel supply. It cites synergies from linking the transportation and real estate businesses, including having business partners of its condominium sales and leasing operations and home buyers use its taxis and buses.
